decisions.reason: The Cards roadmap does name reshelving as work that follows it, though it lists no candidate. I corrected the candidate line to say that and made it the owner choice whether the plan stands with none or waits for a roadmap change; I cannot change a roadmap myself.

The terminal command covers only the block level of the spec governed action and cannot honor the other levels or the host ceiling. The plan already said so in a non-goal; I made the goal and the deferred work state outright that the spec requirement stays unmet and that the owner decides whether it must be met before any book moves.

Checked in the code: the store has no lock over root files, only a catalog lock in the index root, and set_shelf is an unlocked read and replace. My claim of a writer lock was wrong. The plan now holds the catalog lock, re-reads each root file before and after a write, states the narrow guarantee, asks the owner to run nothing else meanwhile, and defers a shared root-file lock.
